facts.fact: 开车路上 George 伸手越过挡把轻捏她的大腿，她觉得这像关系解锁了新的亲密层。
facts.anchor: He reaches an arm across the gear stick and gently squeezes my thigh.

facts.fact: 见家长这场会面可能改变一切、甚至毁掉他们的关系——她还没见到人就先恨上了。
facts.anchor: This is the one that could change everything, potentially ruining what we have. I already hate her for it.

facts.fact: 她的算盘：先赢取他妈妈的信任，再帮她注册交友网站，让她有事可忙、少掺和儿子的生活。
facts.anchor: Perhaps after I gain her trust, she’ll allow me to set her up with an online dating profile.

facts.fact: George 和他妈妈亲密到每天视频通话，她觉得这种关系瘆人。
facts.anchor: They even FaceTime each other. Every fucking day.

facts.fact: 她瞄准那枚白金托粉色摩根石戒指——是从他忘了关的 iPad 浏览标签页里看到的。
facts.anchor: the pink morganite with a white-gold band, the one I saw on his iPad because he forgot to close the browsing tab

facts.fact: 朋友和酒吧熟人都说她疯了：那人有所图，没男人这么快放弃自由。
facts.anchor: ‘Bullshit,’ they’d say. ‘That guy is at it. He’s after something.

facts.fact: 三个月砸下一个个里程碑；她认为放弃独立、搬出格拉斯哥市中心的舒联合租屋，是自己做过最正确的决定。
facts.anchor: Three months in and I’m continuing to smash pivotal milestones like a game of whack-a-mole and giving up my independence and walking away from a cushy flatshare in the city centre of Glasgow was the best decision I’ve ever made.

facts.fact: 她离开酒吧工作是 George 的主意——他不想让她深夜独自在外。
facts.anchor: It was his idea; he didn’t want me out alone late at night anymore.
